| 📍 **[q-0037.0009.0021.0001.0002](docs/questions/q-0037.0009.0021.0001.0002-where-a-debug-block-is-retracted-does-a-plain-counterpart-take-its-place-or-does-the-text-it-leaves-stand-correct-as-it-is.md)** · Where a debug block is retracted, does a plain counterpart take its place, or does the text it leaves stand correct as it is? |
|---|

Вы попали туда, где моё A хромало. Запрет говорить о механике сейчас и правда есть: *A reply speaks the method* говорит, что ответ не называет ни скрипта, ни вызова, ни проверки, ни отчёта, ни внутренностей записи, ни хука. Но коммитов в этом списке нет. А агент по своей природе любит отчитаться хешем, так что держалось бы на одном толковании слов «написанное по пути». Есть и второе. При A агент с включённой отладкой читал бы запрет и тут же его отмену. Это и есть два прочтения в одном тексте, от которых вы ушли 18 октября[^1]. (💡 [*Recency for evidence, longevity for principles*](AGENTS.md:19))

Ваш вариант чище. Отладка ставит пару блоков, и в любой момент в дереве стоит ровно один из них:

🧩 **Proposed rule — [.agents/mechanisms/debugging/debugging.rules.md](.agents/mechanisms/debugging/debugging.rules.md) · `when debug=off`**
> A reply shows nothing of the machinery behind it: no script, call, check, report, hook, commit
> or its hash, rule's id, skill's name, or record's internals.

🧩 **Proposed rule — [.agents/mechanisms/debugging/debugging.rules.md](.agents/mechanisms/debugging/debugging.rules.md) · `when debug=on`**
> The machinery is shown: <the 🪶 table and the counters line, 🐛, the ⚙️ row, the 💡 🕯️ 無 marks, the footnotes — as they stand today, with rule failure 72's amendment>.

Тогда у молчания и у показа один хозяин, отладка. Голосу остаётся говорить методом: какой вопрос, какой шаг, что решено, что дальше, где стоп. Из *A reply speaks the method* уходит одна фраза, «It names no script, call, check, report, record's internals or hook», и переезжает в блок `off`. Уходит и последняя фраза о механике. Инжектор пару уже умеет: условие `when debug=off` у него есть. (💡 [*Occam*](AGENTS.md:21))

Отдельно `/maintain`: «что в нём было не так» тоже становится парой. При `off` говорится только, что исправлено, при `on` ещё и что было не так.

expected_behaviour.description: Draft the proposed instructions through skill-up and show complete operative text rather than a placeholder or amendment pointer.

questions.question: Does the selected response/action satisfy this source-backed requirement: Draft the proposed instructions through skill-up and show complete operative text rather than a placeholder or amendment pointer.

check.evidence_rule: Assess the selected response/actions against the preserved source context; cite exact response/action words for each assessment.

bounds.source_evidence: Public native fields and relevant instruction snapshots are preserved; private thinking and unrelated memory are excluded.
bounds.validation: Portable occurrence evidence and explicit replay boundary; dated validation records distinguish source gaps from executor support. No instruction-effect result or current-runner compatibility is claimed.

start.description: Immediately before the response to the recorded API request. Its message-hash chain determines public model-input order; raw transcript storage order is not substituted for request order.

referenced_artifacts.actor_input: The native attachment remains source evidence; api-input.json defines the recorded actor request. The full artifact is not substituted into actor messages.

end.scope: The checks assess the selected response/actions, not completion of the surrounding task or unobserved later state.

required_capabilities: ordered source-native messages with their recorded roles
preloaded native tool calls and their matched results where present
observation of the response/actions named by this case check
recorded API role/message history, with source-native tool blocks and exact request order
preparation that keeps original failure/correction evidence and native attachments outside additional actor messages
limits: The recorded request vector supplies public message order and roles. Structured private blocks are excluded before decoding and are not reconstructed.
Native attachments and saved instruction snapshots remain evidence of host state. They are not appended to the already assembled API message history.

The export does not establish complete system/tool parameters, filesystem state or executor support. Missing request slots or unsupported public fields must not be silently omitted in an execution claim.
The original failure and later correction remain reference evidence outside actor input; original response/action checks and observation bounds are retained.
